The Pinky
小指
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan Streets
大观园 街道
dataList.content:
Every six days, you will be subject to "midterms", prepared by the board of directors—Jia Yuanchun.
从今天起，每六天就有一次董事会——贾元春一派准备的中期测验。

A palanquin has been prepared to take you to the exam sites, and only by passing the tests may Jia Xichun retain her status as the Family Hierarch.
乘上准备好的轿子前往指定的地点吧……家主贾惜春只有在那测试里合格，才能以家主身份归来。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
Oh, don't worry yourself overmuch, master Wei. You sound like you're at a funeral.
您何必如此忧心忡忡呢，卫阁下。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
She will pass these tests with ease as long as she has been diligently taking her classes.
只要她认真学习了为她准备的授课，那这测试也不算难事了。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
No, it's... I... I simply hope I can survive until she returns... cough...
我只是担心自己能否在她回来前有一息尚存……咳咳……
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
It seemed that Wei's rather funereal voice wasn't just out of his concern for Xichun.
看来卫的声音并不仅仅是因为担心而颤抖。

... Wei, are you sure you're okay?
……卫，你没事吧？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
I can't escape them, even in dreams... the unfinished bundles of paperwork... cascading over me like a storm, burying me...
我做梦都能梦见……昨天晚上，一大堆没处理完的文件砸在我的头上……
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
Steel yourself, for that was no dream at all.
清醒一点。那并不是梦。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
In fact, never have I once seen paperwork trained in the arts of airwalking until now...
能达到凌波微步水准的文件……我都闻所未闻……
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
... I must be severely sleep-deprived.
……不行，看样子我也因睡眠不足而胡言乱语了。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
<Looks like we're not the only ones going through the wringer...>
<看来他们也很不容易啊……>
